description:
Generate 20+ HD AI images per minute using this ultra-fast Z-Image-Turbo BF16 workflow in ComfyUI – with dead-simple LoRA stacking for characters, styles, and perfect consistency! 🚀

Z-Image-Turbo (distilled 6B-parameter model from Tongyi-MAI / Alibaba) delivers stunning photorealism, sharp details, and solid text rendering in just 8–12 steps — often faster and cleaner than Flux Schnell, especially when stacking multiple LoRAs. The BF16 variant (~12.3 GB) is the go-to for top-tier quality with great efficiency on 16GB+ VRAM GPUs like RTX 4090/5090 or A100.

🔗 FREE WORKFLOWS, COMMUNITY DISCUSSION, 1 ON 1 SESSIONS

- rgthree Power LoRA Loader for easy stacking (up to 4+ LoRAs with trigger words & strength control)
- Qwen CLIP text encoder for excellent prompt following
- Heavy-duty negative prompt to eliminate deformed hands, extra limbs, artifacts, bad lighting & more
- Euler sampler, low steps, portrait-friendly 720×1280 resolution (easy to scale)
- Batch tricks to push 20+ high-quality images per minute

Perfect for artists, content creators, marketers, AI Influncers, or anyone who hates waiting ages for each generation.

Pro tips covered: prepend prompt magic, ideal LoRA strengths (start at 1.0), batch size hacks, sampler & CFG tweaks, real-time speed benchmarks, and more.
